_note: Fixtures cut from the REAL cached corpus pages by DOM pruning. Nothing is hand-authored: each file is the page's own <title>, its own og:title / price / currency meta tags, its own application/ld+json blocks, and the verbatim subtrees containing every rendered text node that carries an ISO-4217 code. Each cut is GATED: the adjacency rung, a naive any-code-in-text scan, _page_currency_evidence and (faces.ae) extract_price_from_html return the SAME values on the cut as on the full cached page.
corpus: _proof/sweep2_curl_cffi.jsonl + _proof/html/ (sha1 of 'curl_cffi|'+url); _proof/global/corpus.json + _proof/global/html/ (sha1 of url) -- both read-only, git-excluded
